page.layout: Full-width dedication heading at the top, centred, in capitals and spaced type, with a printed ornament above it. Below it, one column of running text with a large initial at its start. A water stain covers the left part of the first body lines. A signature mark sits at the bottom right.

main_text.head: GENEROSISSIMO ET SPLENDIDISSIMO COmitiac domino, Do. Philippo Ludouico, Comiti in Hanavv & Rinek, domino in Mintzenberg, &c. Franc. Hotomanus S.
main_text.p: NCI[?] sunt ferè q. [illegible, ~5 letters] or & viginti, Ge[illegible, ~3 letters] ner[illegible, ~3 letters]e Comes Philippe, ex quo tātum in arte Dialectica praesidium ad juris civilis cognitionem esse animadverti, ut ex eo tempore nunquam ferè desistiterim, quae ad illius artis usum pertinere arbitrabar, privato mihi studio notare atque seponere. Quinetiam omnes ferè Aristotelis

page.notes: The first line of the body is partly lost under a blue water stain and an ornament. The large initial is hard to read; "NCI" is a best reading. Words marked as illegible sit under the stain and ornament. The reading "Genere" is a guess from the split word across lines 2 and 3, so the lost letters may differ. The stain covers the right edge of the line "seponere", and the closing mark there is read as a full stop. No running head or page number is printed. The page contains no marginal notes.
